title: Thrummelspar's Countdown Bells
story: High in the clocktower of Ashlin, Thrummelspar the Belfry Beetle chews through the bell ropes so the town cannot ring the flood warning. The beetle gnaws one rope every 4 minutes without stopping, and there are 19 ropes left. Mr 6 can climb from the square to the belfry in a fixed number of minutes and must arrive before the last rope falls.
question: How many minutes does Mr 6 have before the very last rope is chewed through?
hint: Each rope takes the same amount of time. How many groups of 4 minutes are there in 19 ropes?
victory: Mr 6 arrived with eleven minutes to spare, rang the flood bell, and offered Thrummelspar a chewy licorice rope instead. The beetle declared it far tastier and retired from villainy.
